display.description: House of Ill Omens quest offer, reminder, and turn-in scene.
display.title: House of Ill Omens

lines: Good. Some work only looks lighter after you pick it back up.
Are you sure you want me to put this quest aside?

abandoned: Then I will set this aside. Come back if the work still matters.
abandoned_cooldown: Then I will set this aside for a while. Let the trail cool before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then this matter is closed. I will not reopen it.
unavailable: There is no active trail here for me to fold away.

lines: Then keep the work close until you are ready.
House of Ill Omens is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: A Totem of Undying. That is not proof of safety, but it is proof the village has a shield with a name.
inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
missing_objectives: The evoker must fall, and the informants still need 12 emeralds.
missing_proof: Bring the Totem. Nothing else carries enough of that house on it.
missing_target: The totem needs the mansion behind it. I need the place confirmed.
unavailable: This quest is not ready to close yet.

lines: Reasonable. I dislike when reason wins this neatly.
There is a house in the woods where bad ideas learned carpentry. I want its power counted, not ignored.
A mansion has been named in too many frightened reports. Bring down its evoker, bring a Totem of Undying, and pay the people who pointed us there.

inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
reminder: Woodland Mansion near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring down the evoker, bring the Totem, then 12 emeralds for the informants.
unavailable: That quest is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: House of Ill Omens is already settled.
locate_failed: The mansion is beyond my reach today. The woods are keeping their mouth shut.
started: The mansion lies {direction}, around {distance} blocks away, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Defeat its evoker, bring a Totem of Undying, and set aside 12 emeralds for informants.
unavailable: This is not a request for someone the village only half trusts.

lines: You came back from that house. I am already impressed; now show me why.
Then hold onto it until you are ready to settle the matter.
